name: Tony Stark
subtitle: The Futurist

passives.name: Genius Engineer
passives.description: Tony may interact with Tech and Gear effects that normally require an engineering-capable character.

passives.name: Always Improving
passives.description: Effects that upgrade or modify Tony may retain benefits when he evolves if the new card permits them.

activeAbility.name: Improvise
activeAbility.description: Once per turn, Tony may manipulate, examine or repurpose a compatible Tech effect in play.

description: A brilliant engineer with an enormous ego, extraordinary resources and absolutely no armour protecting him yet.
flavorText: Give him enough time and eventually the problem becomes a prototype.

name: Steve Rogers
subtitle: The Little Guy

passives.name: Indomitable
passives.description: Steve cannot be forced to surrender while another allied character remains active.

passives.name: The Little Guy
passives.description: Effects triggered by protecting, assisting or standing against a stronger opponent may treat Steve as eligible regardless of his current form.

activeAbility.name: Stand Between
activeAbility.description: Once per round, Steve may become the target of an effect aimed at an allied character.

description: Physically frail and chronically underestimated, but already possessing the one thing no serum will ever be able to give him.
flavorText: Strength was never the part that made him dangerous.

name: Unworthy Thor
subtitle: Son of Odin, Grounded

passives.name: Born Warrior
passives.description: Thor retains exceptionally strong physical base stats even while stripped of divine power.

activeAbility.name: Prove Worthy
activeAbility.description: Thor may interact with effects that test Worthiness, sacrifice or selflessness.

description: Stripped of his power and separated from his weapon, Thor is temporarily reduced to an unusually large, extremely confused man.
flavorText: A god can lose his power long before he learns what made him worthy of it.

name: Bruce Banner
subtitle: Before the Gamma

passives.name: Brilliant Scientist
passives.description: Bruce may interact with Science effects and scientific conditions that other characters cannot.

passives.name: Latent Rage
passives.description: Damage, stress and anger effects applied to Bruce may be referenced by future Hulk evolutions.

activeAbility.name: Analyse
activeAbility.description: Bruce may examine one active scientific, radiation or transformation effect each turn.

description: A gifted physicist whose greatest contribution to brute-force combat currently involves knowing quite a lot about gamma radiation.
flavorText: For now, the monster exists only as a possibility.

name: Natasha Romanoff
subtitle: Red Room Operative

passives.name: Trained Observer
passives.description: Natasha may gain information from hidden, concealed or unrevealed game elements when another effect permits scouting.

passives.name: Infiltrator
passives.description: Natasha may interact with espionage, infiltration and sabotage objectives regardless of her current evolution.

passives.name: Misdirection
passives.description: Effects that reward deception or manipulating an opponent's choices may reference Natasha as an eligible character.

activeAbility.name: Read the Room
activeAbility.description: Once per round, inspect one piece of information normally hidden from you if another game effect has made it partially observable.

description: No armour, no super serum and no divine weapon - merely an exceptionally dangerous human trained to win before the fight becomes fair.
flavorText: The easiest fight to survive is the one your opponent never realised had started.

name: Clint Barton
subtitle: The Marksman

passives.name: Perfect Aim
passives.description: Clint may receive additional benefits from future Precision and Ranged effects.

passives.name: Patient Hunter
passives.description: Effects that reward waiting, preparing or selecting a target may treat Clint as specially eligible.

activeAbility.name: Mark Target
activeAbility.description: Choose one opposing character as Clint's marked target until you choose another.

description: A highly trained field operative whose most famous weapon has not yet been placed in his hands.
flavorText: He only needs the target to make one mistake.

name: James Rhodes
subtitle: Air Force Colonel

passives.name: Military Training
passives.description: Rhodey may fully utilise Military Gear and weapons that require trained personnel.

activeAbility.name: Coordinate
activeAbility.description: Choose one allied character. Effects representing coordinated or tactical actions may treat that ally as linked with Rhodey until his next turn.

description: An experienced military officer with impeccable training and, at this point, absolutely none of Tony Stark's toys.
flavorText: Eventually someone has to bring military doctrine to the flying robot suit.

name: Sam Wilson
subtitle: Pararescueman

passives.name: Rescue Training
passives.description: Sam receives additional interaction options with effects involving extraction, rescue or protecting endangered allies.

passives.name: Wingman
passives.description: Sam may benefit from effects that reward coordinated actions with another allied character.

activeAbility.name: Extract Ally
activeAbility.description: Once per round, Sam may assist an allied character affected by a positioning or control effect.

description: A veteran pararescueman already accustomed to entering terrible situations to bring somebody else home.
flavorText: Before the wings came the instinct to go back for someone.

name: Bucky Barnes
subtitle: Brooklyn Soldier

passives.name: Combat Veteran
passives.description: Bucky may efficiently use Military Gear and effects requiring battlefield training.

passives.name: Loyal to the End
passives.description: Effects involving protecting or supporting Steve Rogers may receive additional interactions when Bucky is active.

activeAbility.name: Covering Action
activeAbility.description: Once per round, Bucky may support an allied character performing a tactical action.

description: A capable soldier and fiercely loyal friend long before anyone rebuilt him into something more dangerous.
flavorText: The machine came later. The soldier was already there.

name: Wanda Maximoff
subtitle: Sokovian Survivor

passives.name: Survivor
passives.description: Wanda may gain benefits from future effects triggered by loss, hardship or surviving damage.

passives.name: Latent Potential
passives.description: Wanda is eligible for exceptionally powerful transformation and ability effects that reference latent supernatural potential.

description: A young Sokovian carrying extraordinary potential that has not yet become something she understands or controls.
flavorText: Some power announces itself. Some waits.

name: Deconstructed Vision
subtitle: Some Assembly Required

passives.name: Synthetic Potential
passives.description: Vision may receive Synthetic, AI and advanced-material evolution effects despite not yet being an active combatant.

passives.name: Empty Vessel
passives.description: Effects involving artificial intelligence, synthetic bodies or the Mind Stone may use Vision as a valid host.

description: A collection of astonishingly advanced components which, at present, has all the battlefield utility of expensive furniture.
flavorText: Technically, most people also begin as a pile of ingredients.

name: Scott Lang
subtitle: Second-Story Man

passives.name: Burglar
passives.description: Scott may interact with infiltration, theft and bypass effects that reward unconventional access.

passives.name: Improviser
passives.description: Scott may benefit from future effects involving unconventional solutions or repurposed technology.

activeAbility.name: Break In
activeAbility.description: Once per round, Scott may attempt to bypass a non-character obstacle or defensive effect.

description: An electrical engineer, talented burglar and devoted father who has not yet encountered the world's least sensibly regulated shrinking technology.
flavorText: Every impossible fortress eventually has a way in.

name: Peter Parker
subtitle: Queens Kid

passives.name: Gifted Student
passives.description: Peter may interact with Science and Tech effects requiring exceptional technical aptitude.

passives.name: Great Power Waiting
passives.description: Peter is eligible for Spider transformation effects that radically modify his base statistics.

activeAbility.name: Science Project
activeAbility.description: Peter may examine or interact with one Science or Tech effect each turn.

description: A brilliant but otherwise ordinary teenager from Queens immediately before his life becomes considerably less ordinary.
flavorText: Right now the greatest danger in his life is probably homework.

name: Stephen Strange
subtitle: Master Surgeon

passives.name: Photographic Mind
passives.description: Stephen may gain additional interactions with effects involving study, learning, complex knowledge or discovering new abilities.

passives.name: Obsessive Mastery
passives.description: Effects that reward repeated study or mastering difficult techniques may progress more effectively on Stephen.

activeAbility.name: Diagnose
activeAbility.description: Inspect one condition affecting a character and reveal all currently visible information about that condition.

description: One of the world's finest surgeons, possessing extraordinary hands, extraordinary intelligence and absolutely no idea magic exists.
flavorText: He has spent his life mastering one impossible discipline. Another is waiting.

name: T'Challa
subtitle: Prince of Wakanda

passives.name: Warrior Prince
passives.description: T'Challa may interact with advanced combat training, leadership and Wakandan effects even without Panther enhancements.

passives.name: Wakandan Heir
passives.description: T'Challa is eligible for restricted Wakandan Gear, rituals and lineage effects.

activeAbility.name: Command
activeAbility.description: Choose one allied character. Until T'Challa's next turn, that character may be treated as participating in a coordinated action with him.

description: A prince raised among the most advanced people on Earth, already a formidable fighter before ritual or vibranium transforms his role.
flavorText: The suit does not make the king.
